research_question: With the P3o-J mechanism unchanged but a repaired D-drive generation contract, can a detached-posterior component residual improve cross-identity parameter risk over the identical shared-mean residual without changing recognition?
relation_to_prior: P3o-J had no train or development result: 1450M generation was incomplete because C: exhausted. P3o-L changes only identity seeds and the storage/durability contract, not architecture, loss, hyperparameters, thresholds, checkpoint rule, or scientific gates.

methods.L0_shared_mean: Finite-valid state-preserving bounded shared delay residual, mean masked Smooth-L1.
methods.L1_component_conditioned: Exactly L0 plus a learnable 6x12 correction selected only by detached six-label sigmoid posterior probabilities.

training.calibration: F-only calibration reused verbatim by L0/L1

decision_rule: Only a three-successful-seed all-gate pass permits exactly 1550M confirmation. Any incomplete 15-view generation, exception, non-finite output, missing receipt, or gate failure freezes P3o-L. No rerun, tune, calibration, checkpoint selection, or confirmation can reuse 1530M/1540M after development access.
